entries.label: s2_sub_012_intro_01
entries.text: Ohoho! Would you look at the cut of your jib!\nYou must be the one everyone’s talking ’bout.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_intro_02
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You’re the Paldean exchange student,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)],
or
my
name’s
not
Snacksworth!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_intro_select_01
entries.text: You got me!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_intro_select_02
entries.text: Your name’s what?

entries.label: s2_sub_012_intro_03
entries.text: Yes, indeed! Call me Snacksworth!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_intro_04
entries.text: I do love to see the young students putting some\nreal effort into their self-improvement.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_intro_05
entries.text: Especially the kids who really give their all for\nthe ol’ BBQs. I reward them with snacks!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_intro_06
entries.text: These snacks I make are very special treats—\nmade just to the tastes of certain Pokémon!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_intro_07
entries.text: With one of my snacks in hand, you may find\nyourself running into quite spectacular Pokémon!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_intro_08
entries.text: So come give ol’ Snacksworth the latest whenever\nyou’ve been hard at work on those BBQs!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_main_01
entries.text: Now, let’s see if you’ve been chipping away at\nthose BBQs or not, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...

entries.label: s2_sub_012_main_02_team_00
entries.text: Heavens to Betsy! You’ve gone and completed\na group quest!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_main_02_team
entries.text: Heavens to Betsy! You’ve gone and completed\n[VAR 0x0202(0001)] group quest[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_main_02_normal
entries.text: Heavens to Betsy! You’ve gone and completed\n[VAR 0x0202(0001)] solo quest[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_main_02_less_01
entries.text: Well, shucks. It looks like it’s a bit early for you\nto be getting any of my special snacks.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_main_02_less_02a
entries.text: I reckon you could earn one of my special snacks\nif you did [VAR 0x0202(0002)] more quest[VAR 0x1101(0002,0100)]s on your own...or\r\nmaybe [VAR 0x0202(0003)] more group quest[VAR 0x1101(0003,0100)]s.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_main_02_less_02b
entries.text: I reckon you could earn one of my special snacks\nif you did, say, [VAR 0x0202(0003)] more group quest[VAR 0x1101(0003,0100)]s.\c\nYou’re doing fine work on those solo quests!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_main_02_less_02c
entries.text: I reckon you could earn one of my special snacks\nif you did, say, [VAR 0x0202(0002)] more solo quest[VAR 0x1101(0002,0100)]s.\c\nYou’re doing fine work on those group quests!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_main_02_less_03
entries.text: You know about group quests, right? They’ll start\nappearing once you tackle a whole heap of BBQs\r\nwith your pals using the Union Circle.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_main_02_less_04
entries.text: Or are you just here because you’d like to hear\nmy ol’ tales about rare and wondrous Pokémon?

entries.label: s2_sub_012_main_02_less_05
entries.text: All right, then! What Pokémon would you like to\nhear me yammer on about? Show me their snack!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_main_02_less_06
entries.text: Well, friend, I don’t rightly know what to tell you.\nThat there’s no snack of mine...

entries.label: s2_sub_012_main_02_less_07
entries.text: You sure you want to mosey on without hearing\none of my tales? No need to be shy!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_main_03
entries.text: I’d say you’ve earned yourself one of my special\nsnacks, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].

entries.label: s2_sub_012_main_05
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You know [VAR 0x0101(0005)]? Frightfully rare,
that
one!
Not
your
run-of-the-mill
Pokémon!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_013_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Articuno...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
See, I’d found this lovely pond up in the snowy
peaks of Paldea and had decided to go for a dip,
hankering for a bit of cold-water swimming...

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_013_02
entries.text: when—would you believe it!—Articuno comes\nswooping down along the nearby waterfall and\r\nstarts flying about above me, singing away!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_013_03
entries.text: I was tickled pink, I was. Went on merrily singing\nwith Articuno even as the sun set and the moon\r\nrose. Before I knew it, it was morning again!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_014_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Zapdos...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
I’d climbed right up to the tippy-top of one of
those lighthouses you’ve got in Paldea, and I was
taking in the view, looking over a distant city...

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_014_02
entries.text:
when—would you believe it!—the heavens broke
wide open, and rain started pouring down on me!\c
I thought I’d better get out of that mess in a
hurry, so I turned to head down again.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_014_03
entries.text: Then the whole sky lit up like a huge crash of\nlightning, and Zapdos came flying outta nowhere!\r\nIt blew right by me, quick as a flash!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_015_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Moltres...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
I was off doing a spot of rock-climbing over in
western Paldea at the time.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_015_02
entries.text:
The weather was sure something else that day!\c
Sandstorms were kicking up the whole desert—
my mouth was as sandy as the ground!\c
I was about ready to call it quits when...

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_015_03
entries.text:
Moltres appeared in a blaze of glory, so bright
you could see it through the blowing sands!\c
I don’t know if it meant to cheer me on, but it
certainly did, and I completed my climb that day.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_016_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Raikou...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
Yes, there was a day me and ol’ Raikou went
racing up a mountain together.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_016_02
entries.text:
That Raikou—it’s no slouch, that’s for sure!
Kept dashing past me and taking the lead.\c
I was huffing and puffing and muttering some
colorful things as I chased that wily Pokémon.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_016_03
entries.text: But in the end, we were sitting side by side atop\nthat peak, gazing out upon the massive and\r\nmajestic desert that covers the land to the north.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_017_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Entei...I do recall this one particular
encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
Would you believe it—I simply ran smack dab
into Entei while out adventuring in Paldea!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_017_02
entries.text:
You know that stretch that’s dotted with mines,
and everywhere you look, there’s another hole?\c
Well, there was Entei, popping through those
caves like it was having a grand ol’ time!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_017_03
entries.text:
I don’t like to be outshone, so I did my best to
keep up with the feller. Whoo-ee, what a chase!\c
We ended up all the way at the coast, side by
side as we gazed out over the endless blue.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_018_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Suicune...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
See, I spotted Suicune once, while I was out
enjoying that famous lake you’ve got in Paldea.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_018_02
entries.text: We ended up having a little contest of skill,\nseeing which one of us could get all the way\r\nto shore fastest.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_018_03
entries.text:
We were off like a shot, but that Suicune—well,
it runs right over the water, now don’t it?\c
Me being just your everyday human, the best
I could manage was a nice, solid backstroke.\c
It was a fine race, though. Mighty fine. Even if
that Suicune did end up beating me by a whisker.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_019_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Lugia...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
I was paddling in the sea off Paldea, enjoying a
leisurely backstroke through those crystal waters.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_019_02
entries.text:
But it was a real frigid stretch of sea, you
understand. Didn’t take long in that water before
I’d started to lose all the warmth in my body!\c
I was shaking like a leaf by the time I found an
island and crawled ashore.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_019_03
entries.text:
What should appear before me but a great
whirlpool heaving in the sea, and—bwoosh!
Out of it comes Lugia itself!\c
I was knocked flat on my backside in the shock
of it all, so delighted I forgot I was even cold!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_020_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Ho-Oh...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
Now this is a real old tale, from those long ago
days when I’d just started out as a Trainer...

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_020_02
entries.text:
I was down in the southwest of Paldea, near the
cascading waterfalls down there.\c
I’d been up through the night, training without
rest to try to make my Pokémon stronger.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_020_03
entries.text:
Then Ho-Oh appears in the sky above me,
glittering and sparkling bright as you ever saw!\c
I’d sure like to believe that it appeared there to
cheer me on when I was trying so hard.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_021_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Latias...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
I was off enjoying a spot of backstroke in the
sea to the south of Paldea at the time.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_021_02
entries.text:
I’d been going on for a good while, so I’d come
to feel a bit tuckered out and in need of a rest.\c
Came ashore to rest on the sand in the shadow
of some cliffs...

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_021_03
entries.text:
when—you won’t even believe it—there’s Latias!
Just right there before me!\c
Our eyes met, and it gave me a jolly little smile.
Then it flew off again out of sight.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_022_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Latios...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
One day I ran smack dab into it, brazen as you
please, while I was up in northeast Paldea, see.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_022_02
entries.text:
We couldn’t speak each other’s language, but
I got the feeling it was telling me to follow it.\c
So I gave chase when Latios flew off, and I
ended up climbing these mighty steep cliffs.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_022_03
entries.text: Next time I looked up, I realized I’d come to a\nsmall lake, nestled in between some jagged cliffs.\r\nIt was a secret spot, all right.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_023_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Kyogre...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
I was on another one of my adventures around
Paldea when I spotted these odd rocks in the sea.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_023_02
entries.text:
I thought to myself, “Now, Snacksworth, those’ve
got to be those famous rocks said to bring riches!”\c
So I figured I might as well squeeze my eyes shut
real tight and make a wish on ’em.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_023_03
entries.text:
After a few seconds, I opened my eyes, and what
should appear in front of those rocks but Kyogre!\c
Just big and blue and brazen as you please!
Now that was a shocking day, make no mistake!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_024_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Groudon...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
I did spy ol’ Groudon once, back in the days
when I was adventuring around Paldea.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_024_02
entries.text:
You know the huge cave system under that
one town? I never can remember the name...\c
Anyway, the name don’t matter, except to say
that that’s the place where I saw that feller!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_024_03
entries.text:
I thought to myself, “Well, if that ain’t Groudon!”
And I gave a big wave of my arms to say hello.\c
What else are you supposed to do when faced
with the Continent Pokémon, I ask you?\c
So anyway, I did that. And then it showed me its
huge, fearsome claws, that it did.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_025_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Rayquaza...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
I was doing a bit of mountain climbing—hauling
myself up some mighty steep Paldean cliffs.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_025_02
entries.text:
When I made it up to the top—now that was the
kind of sight a man lives for!\c
I looked down over the edge into a sea of white
mist, unbroken as far as the eye could see!
There was something truly mystical about it all.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_025_03
entries.text: And what came bursting right outta that dense\nfog but ol’ Rayquaza, like a cork outta a bottle!\r\nI nearly fell back down the mountain in shock!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_026_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Cobalion...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
I was on one of my adventures in Paldea when
Cobalion just pranced on down from a cliff.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_026_02
entries.text:
I was real flummoxed at first when it stopped
right before me. Maybe it was just pausing to
stare because my face looked so funny?\c
Anyway, that ol’ Cobalion started to stroll away,
so I followed, and it led me to a famed waterfall.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_026_03
entries.text: I tried to say thanks, but ol’ Cobalion just dashed\noff into the bamboo grove, cool as you please.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_027_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Terrakion...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
It was just a regular day, and I was out doing a
bit of my beloved rock-climbing, as I’m wont to.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_027_02
entries.text:
I’d made it up quite high. When I turned around
for a breath, I could just make out Cortondo in
the distance, off to the south.\c
I was simply standing there, admiring that view...
when next thing I knew, Terrakion had plonked
down for a sit right beside me!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_027_03
entries.text: Perhaps it was simply at loose ends? It sat with\nme for a time, and we ate some snacks together.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_028_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Virizion...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
I tell you no lies: I simply came across Virizion
resting among the trees one day while I was on
one of my adventures around Paldea!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_028_02
entries.text:
And what trees they were! All done up in these
mysterious patterns like I’ve never seen.\c
We stayed there a good while, me and Virizion,
gazing at one another twixt those fanciful trees.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_028_03
entries.text:
But that ol’ Virizion, it didn’t run off. Just gave
me this curious look, you know?\c
So I sat there and told it about my adventures,
and it listened with a kindly air the whole time.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_029_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Reshiram...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
See, I saw Reshiram with my own eyes, out near
a town that I’d passed through in Paldea.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_029_02
entries.text:
It was a town where a lot of hardworking folk
live—the type that get their hands dirty.\c
I’d climbed up to a nice height to look out upon
all their hard work, carved into the landscape.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_029_03
entries.text:
I was just remarking to myself what a fine show
of effort it was, when I seemed to feel a presence
behind me. And when I turned—bam!\c
There was Reshiram, right at my shoulder! I figure
it must like good ol’-fashioned hard work, too.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_030_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Zekrom...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
I’d set out from Mesagoza, thinking I would walk
all the way out to Artazon from there.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_030_02
entries.text:
I was making fine progress, when this great black
shadow streaks across the sky to the east.\c
I was consumed with curiosity—that’s for sure—so
I climbed real high to try to catch a better look...
and wouldn’t you know it—there was Zekrom!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_030_03
entries.text:
I stared up at it like a country lad seeing his first
city, and it came down to land right near me.\c
We watched one another for a time. I couldn’t
help but bask in how magnificent Zekrom is.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_031_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Kyurem...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
See, I was up climbing the snowy mountains when
a terrible storm blew in, and I had no choice
really but to hunker down in a cave underground.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_031_02
entries.text:
Don’t even rightly know if I should call that place
a cave. It was all soaring heights and wide
passages—befuddling as any labyrinth too.\c
I was having a grand time exploring its many
nooks and crannies when this sheet of ice near
me suddenly up and moved!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_031_03
entries.text:
I rubbed my eyes, not believing what I was
seeing, once I realized—it was no ice sheet!
It was Kyurem, right there in front of me!\c
Who would believe it, right?

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_032_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Solgaleo...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
I’d gone to pay Paldea’s Pokémon League a little
visit at that fine building they’ve got there.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_032_02
entries.text:
I was just admiring the structure from the outside
when one of the staffers noticed me and invited
me in for a better look.\c
They took me up to the observation deck,
all done up with that logo of theirs.\c
I was looking toward the academy and enjoying
the view when a shadow fell across us.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_032_03
entries.text:
I kid you not, young friend. It was Solgaleo itself!\c
It was only there a moment before it dashed right
off again in a flash, so I couldn’t even get in a
how-do-you-do. But it was magnificent!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_033_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Lunala...I do recall this one particular
encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
I was on a fine sandy beach in Paldea, gazing out
at the sun as it set into the sea.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_033_02
entries.text:
Looking at the sun really reminds you just how
small you are as one person, you know?\c
I was getting all sentimental as I watched the
light slipping away.\c
It hadn’t yet disappeared when suddenly this
great crescent moon bloomed before my eyes!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_033_03
entries.text:
It was only there for an instant, so it was hard
to get a good look.\c
But I’m sure that silhouette belonged to Lunala,
or my name’s not Snacksworth.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_034_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Necrozma...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
I was sitting in the stream of one of Paldea’s
waterfalls, letting the pounding water cleanse
my mind...\c
when I looked up and saw Necrozma sat right
up above, giving me the ugliest glare!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_034_02
entries.text: I thought it’d be unwise of me not to stand my\nground, so I squared up and roared as loud as\r\nthe water! That had ol’ Necrozma off like a shot.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_034_03
entries.text: And it wasn’t just Necrozma either! That shout\nof mine sent all the nearby Sawsbuck scattering,\r\ntoo, wouldn’t you know it! Hahahaha!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_035_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Kubfu...I do recall this one particular
encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
I was adventuring off in Paldea when I saw Kubfu
training! I ambled right up to it and asked,
“Ohoho, hard at work training, are you?”\c
Why, the two of us got on like a house on fire!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_035_02
entries.text: We trained together for a time, till Kubfu seemed\nto be itching to move on.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_035_03
entries.text: But it left me a gift—it plucked up a haul of the\nbamboo sprouts that grew nearby, just for me.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_036_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Glastrier...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
I was off hiking among Paldea’s peaks for a bit
of fun, mountain climbing being a bit of a hobby.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_036_02
entries.text:
I was trekking up and up those snowy hillsides,
and I figured I must have been nearly to the
summit when I came across some ruins.\c
Perhaps they’d been a house once? The walls
still looked sound enough that I thought I could
take shelter and have myself a little rest.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_036_03
entries.text:
I’d no sooner drawn close for a look than this
Pokémon appeared, white as the driven snow!\c
Glastrier’d been sleeping inside! When it popped
its long face out, the fright nearly froze my heart!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_037_01
entries.text:
Speaking of Spectrier...I do recall this one
particular encounter when I was a younger feller.\c
I was off hiking among Paldea’s peaks for a bit
of fun, mountain climbing being a bit of a hobby.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_037_02
entries.text:
I was taking my sweet time meandering up some
mountain paths dotted sparsely with trees.\c
I came upon this old ruin on the path, covered
in vines, and I thought to myself, “Now, doesn’t
that seem as good a place as any to take a rest?”

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_037_03
entries.text:
I’d no sooner drawn close for a look than this
black shadow of a Pokémon appeared!\c
Spectrier’d been sleeping inside! It popped its
long face out and scared the spirit outta me!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_end_01
entries.text: It loves that snack you have there, so you might\njust have a shot at meeting it too!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_end_02
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]If you run into ol’ [VAR 0x0101(0005)], you be sure
to
give
it
my best!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_end_clear_01
entries.text: Huh? Well, knock me over with a feather! Looks\nlike you’ve completely cleared me out of snacks!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_end_clear_02
entries.text: Simply goes to show how much hard work you’ve\nput into those BBQs, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].

entries.label: s2_sub_012_story_end_clear_03
entries.text: I’m afraid I’ve no more snacks, but please stop\nby and lend an ear to my old tales now and then!

entries.label: s2_sub_012_main_cleared_01
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]! You back for another
round
of
ol’
Snacksworth’s
tales
of glory?

entries.label: s2_sub_012_chat_01
entries.text:
Ol’ Snacksworth’s been all over the world. I’ve
walked many routes—and not only in Paldea.\c
There are so many lands to explore and so many
tasty snacks to discover in each one...

entries.label: s2_sub_012_chat_02
entries.text:
I’ve got a knack for Pokémon battles myself,
I’d say. Or I did in my glory days.\c
Me and my partner Arbok were known to be
unbeatable back in the parts where I came from.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_chat_03
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]! What a delight to
see
you
again.\c
Sure puts a smile on my face—and a tune to my
lips! Here, I reckon you know this one...\c
“Oh, give me a home where the Bouffalant roam,
where the Deerling and Sawsbuck still play”... ♪

entries.label: s2_sub_012_chat_04
entries.text:
My snacks are actually made using fairly
ordinary ingredients.\c
The Pokémon must love ’em so much because of
the care I put into making ’em. I imagine how
happy the Pokémon’ll be as I craft each treat.

entries.label: s2_sub_012_chat_05
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]’Course I can’t understand the tongues of
Pokémon, but when our eyes meet, it still feels
as though I can guess what they’re thinking.
Don’t you find that to be the case,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?\c
Hahaha! Life’s a real mystery sometimes, ain’t it!
